model_governor_v4.note: Governor scores are shadow-only and cannot alter veteran gate, exact-pair survival gate, alerts, or automatic trading.

wallet_transaction_intelligence_v5.policy: No transaction is counted as buy/sell unless verified_swap=true and exact token+pair identity matches the survivor row. Wallet/cluster labels affect research scores only when explicitly verified by the upstream feed.

pre_wave_fusion_v6.policy: V6 is a shadow fusion layer. Transaction intelligence confirms the research score only with verified exact-pair swaps. Missing wallet/social/holder evidence reduces certainty but is never interpreted as negative evidence.
